phase_name: Pin the incidental cross-tree non-replay protection

objectives.description: Add Test C to test-lake-build-guard.sh asserting decide_sharing() refuses a cross-tree replay over a raw cp -al clone, with a comment explaining the incidental path-embedding protection; verify load-bearing via a reverted local mutation

approaches_tried.approach: Test C initial implementation used cp -al only for .lake/ and plain cp -r for lakefile.toml/lean-toolchain/src/bin
approaches_tried.reason: cp -r resets mtimes on the copied source files, which independently defeats stat-mode fingerprint sharing regardless of path-embedding -- confirmed by manually mutating compute_fingerprint() to strip path-embedding and finding Test C still passed (for the wrong reason). Replaced with a full cp -al hardlink clone of the whole root (content AND mtime identical across trees, only the path differs), which correctly goes red against the same mutation and green against unmutated code.
